info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Drops-v2-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Drop Management API provides essential functionality for monitoring and managing student enrollment drops within an educational institution. This endpoint allows authorized users to retrieve a list of drops in enrollments, facilitating the analysis of student retention trends. Educational administrators and analysts can utilize this information to make informed decisions about student support initiatives and program improvements. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their understanding of enrollment dynamics and proactively address potential issues affecting student success.

get.summary: Drop an enrollment from the system.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to drop an enrollment, removing it from their active list. Ensure that you have the required permissions to perform this action and that the enrollment exists.
